test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 08 Feb 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Seven people, A, B, C, D, E, F and G are sitting in a straight line, facing north. Only two people sit to the right of E. Only two people sit between E and A. B sits second to the right of A. D sits to the immediate right of F. C sits at one of the positions to the left of G. Who sits at the extreme left end of the line?
solution:
Given: Seven people, A, B, C, D, E, F and G.

1) Only two people sit to the right of E.

2) Only two people sit between E and A.

3) B sits second to the right of A.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/778d0023d48c59d2ecd861e56cab0b23015434f4978796e414cc004e0c2998a2.png] 

4) D sits to the immediate right of F.

5) C sits at one of the positions to the left of G.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/16a0809948e9880fdcb163dde1a4f13efd149c984bb0e329399240135abf7b89.png] 

Here, C sits at the extreme left end of the line.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 4"**.
